definitions.eta_p: v_p(E-1) only when a named immediate d=1 regeneration token with E>1 is active; otherwise 0

admission_tickets.PHASE_DROP: rho equal and (major_phase, protocol) lexicographically drops
admission_tickets.LOCAL_DROP: rho and phase/protocol equal and canonical local tuple drops

hard_rules: pending normalization is not a proof edge
macro internal checkpoints are not persistent states
RESET may not return to CHARGED/PRE/ABSORB at the same rho
joined-support reset that lowers charged rank remains CHARGED rather than using RESET
GENERIC_MARKED has no same-rho recursive successor unless a named phase adapter is introduced
